score.title: Activity score
score.explain: The score combines how recently any branch received a commit, commit volume over 90 and 365 days, release cadence and the share of bug-fix work. Archived projects always score 1; projects silent for over a year are capped.
footer.about: Scores are computed automatically from public GitHub data.
